E1 shows nanoscale melting point depression with grain size, supporting the relevance of size-dependent premelting, but does not address the specific Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu system or the effect of Ni content on Cu segregation. The hypothesis accurately represents these findings, though the extrapolation from bulk to nanoparticles and from CoCrCu(Ni) to the quinary system is a minor gap.
